summary: Kidoz Inc., a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer listed on the TSXV and OTC, furnished a Form 6-K containing Exhibit 99.1, a press release announcing its participation in the Planet MicroCap Showcase: Toronto 2026, in partnership with MicroCapClub, on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 10am EST at the Arcadian Loft. CEO Jason Williams will present and take questions; management will hold 1x1 meetings October 27-29. The release touts SDK technology, Kite IQ AI and expansion beyond kids to teen and adult mobile gaming. No transaction, no special-situation event; informational investor-relations notice only, with no deal terms to watch.
